title: Is anyone else out there?
persona: A curious newcomer, signed out, who wants to know whether other people and the city's locals are on the map before deciding to sign up.
goal: Signed out, open the Play tab and look at everything it offers: locals, races, boards, crews. Go back to the map and look for other people's light and the locals. Try to race someone and see what it asks.
success: Locals or other riders' light are visible signed out, and anything that needs an account says so plainly instead of failing silently.
